_meta.name: Adult Smoking Rate
_meta.unit: percent of adults, current cigarette smokers (crude)
_meta.note: NHIS crude prevalence, adults 18+. 2000-2018 from the annual MMWR smoking-prevalence series; 2019-2024 from the NCHS Data Query System (NHIS Adult Summary Health Statistics). NHIS was redesigned in 2019, so the two legs are not strictly comparable across that boundary.
